answer: Resist sybils by gating privileges through a slow attestation graph. At each protocol pulse, an identity may collect one countersignature from an established peer, who locks a slice of stake against that endorsement. Weight stays near zero until the graph reaches its zenith: K independent, non-overlapping attestors across several windows. An attacker who plants an orchard of sockpuppets must bribe many uncorrelated peers—slashed if the cluster fails a honeypot—or lock capital and wait on every fake identity, so herd size costs scale linearly in money, time, and slashing risk.
